basics.name: Tianyu Cao
basics.label: Artificial Intelligence Undergraduate | Computational Biology and Biomedical AI
basics.summary: Undergraduate student in Artificial Intelligence at Hubei University of Economics and research assistant at the Hubei Key Laboratory of Digital Finance Innovation. Research interests: computational biology, generative modeling, representation learning, and biomedical AI.

work.position: Safety-Constrained Generative Modeling for Partial Cellular Reprogramming
work.company: Hubei Key Laboratory of Digital Finance Innovation, Hubei University of Economics
work.role: Research Assistant | Advisor: Associate Professor Ruiheng Li
work.summary: Research on cellular rejuvenation while preserving cell identity.
highlights: Study OSK/OSKM perturbations to balance rejuvenation with cell-identity preservation and biological safety.
Build a conditional flow-matching framework for continuous cell-state trajectories in multi-omics data and identify safe reprogramming windows.
Formulate safety-constrained counterfactual optimization and gene-attribution analyses to generate plausible trajectories while minimizing identity loss and risk.

work.position: SegDrift: Prior-Guided Semantic Drifting for Medical Image Segmentation
work.company: Hubei Key Laboratory of Digital Finance Innovation, Hubei University of Economics
work.role: Research Assistant | Advisor: Associate Professor Ruiheng Li
work.summary: Accepted at IEEE International Conference on Bioinformatics & Biomedicine (BIBM 2026).
highlights: Introduced a DINOv3-guided semantic-drifting framework with a CLS calibration prior and prediction-aware hard-negative mining to address semantic inconsistencies overlooked by pixel-level losses.
Designed a single-step conditional generative process that avoids iterative sampling while preserving semantic consistency.

work.position: Cold-Start Active Learning for Unlabeled Data
work.company: Hubei Key Laboratory of Digital Finance Innovation, Hubei University of Economics
work.role: Research Assistant | Advisor: Associate Professor Ruiheng Li
highlights: Proposed MACS for high-value sample selection in cold-start active learning without labeled data.
Used C-RADIOv4 to extract semantic, structural, and segmentation-related information in a single forward pass, modeling uncertainty through cross-space inconsistency and multi-resolution features.
Developed adaptive clustering and non-uniform budget allocation for informative sample selection under limited annotation budgets.

work.company: Hubei Key Laboratory of Digital Finance Innovation, Hubei University of Economics
work.role: Research Assistant | Advisor: Associate Professor Ruiheng Li
highlights: Studied JointCloud federated learning for privacy-preserving, cross-institutional medical image segmentation and identified persistent representation drift under non-IID data despite parameter-level correction.
Developed a representation-level account of Spectral Representation Collapse using von Neumann entropy to quantify residual performance gaps; manuscript submitted to ICLR 2027.

work.company: Hubei Key Laboratory of Digital Finance Innovation, Hubei University of Economics
work.role: Research Assistant | Advisor: Associate Professor Ruiheng Li
highlights: Proposed an efficient dense-prediction network with a hybrid CNN–RWKV encoder and lightweight decoder for long-range dependency modeling and feature reconstruction.
Achieved 4.8× faster inference and 4.5× lower memory usage, with DSC/F1 improvements of 4–22% over CNNs, 8–58% over Transformers, 1–8% over Mamba, and 10–27% over RWKV-UNet.
Published in the Journal of Computational Design and Engineering.

work.company: Hubei Key Laboratory of Digital Finance Innovation, Hubei University of Economics
work.role: Research Assistant | Advisor: Associate Professor Ruiheng Li
highlights: Proposed a heat-diffusion-inspired segmentation framework with interpretable feature propagation and edge enhancement for anatomical structure and boundary modeling.
Designed and evaluated an efficient encoder–decoder across multiple medical image segmentation datasets.

portfolio.name: MultiAgent-Based CodeReviewer
portfolio.description: AI-powered desktop application for multi-file code review and conversational repair. Six LangGraph expert agents coordinate issue deduplication and conflict resolution. Integrates Tree-sitter project analysis, cross-file symbol search, static analysis, test execution, automated editing, and rollback with a FastAPI/SSE backend and Electron interface.
